reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: Green Cities 2 W2 - Siauliu Bank Energy Efficiency Fund

description.narrative: Provision of a junior loan of up to EUR 25 million in favour of UAB SB modernizavimo fondas 2 (the "Borrower" or "Investment Platform"), a special purpose securitisation vehicle ("SPV"), incorporated in Lithuania and managed by SB, to finance energy efficiency investments in residential multi-apartment buildings ("MAB") in Lithuania (the "Project"). EBRD Loan proceeds to be fully dedicated to MABs located in the city of Vilnius. The Project will help conserve energy, reduce carbon emissions, and encourage the use of energy performance practices to generate energy efficiency ("EE") gains at residential apartment buildings. The Project supports an innovative approach to accelerate the pace of renovation of existing MABs through a combination of long-term debt financing, technical assistance, and support for private households.
